written.headline: Kazakhstan expands AI compute with 45,000 Grace GPUs and new data centers
written.summary: Firebird secured a U.S. export license for 45,000 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs and is building a first‑phase AI data center with Kazakhtelecom, aiming for commercial launch in Q3 2027. Kazakhtelecom has already deployed 880 GPUs and plans to add over 1,000 more next year, while a second phase could raise total AI capacity to about 500 MW.
